// AUDIO VIDEO IMAGE MANIPULATION

> 3D ANIMATION VFX

MATCHING RECORDS: 5

  • Blender:
    Free, open-source 3D creation suite covering modeling, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, and compositing with absolute local data sovereignty.
  • Natron:
    Open-source, node-based digital compositing and VFX suite for rotoscoping, keying, and post-production, acting as a local-first alternative to commercial suites.
  • Pascal Editor:
    A free, open-source 3D building and space planning editor that runs entirely in the browser with local autosave, zero forced signups, and a robust open-source engine stack.
  • Tidewater:
    An open-source interactive WebGL 3D water shader simulation built by Daniel Greenheck, running 100% client-side via GitHub Pages with zero tracking, account gates, or server uploads.
  • Animated Drawings (Meta AI Research):
    An open-source research tool and codebase by Meta AI that automatically detects humanoids in hand-drawn sketches, isolates the figure, extracts a skeleton, and generates animated motion loops entirely without account walls.
